title: fix(plugin-form): a master-detail form's child grid does not offer a cell the caller may read but not edit (objectui#10163)
body:
Fixes #10163
Clause-②: no

**Why `Clause-②: no`, measured on this diff:** it reuses the module-level `applyColumnPermissions` that PR objectui#10233 landed inside `@object-ui/plugin-form`. `git diff` of `MasterDetailForm.tsx` against the base adds or removes **0** lines carrying `export`. The positive control with the same grep shape finds the **1** added `applyColumnPermissions(` call. No prop changes (`usePermissions()` is called inside the internal `MasterDetailLines`, not threaded through `MasterDetailFormProps`). No accept set is relaxed. The fail-open-with-no-provider posture objectui#10161 kept is unchanged and pinned.

This is the remainder objectui#10163 named at its partial-landing release: the master-detail form's own child grid. PR objectui#10233 routed the `record:line_items` panel (`LineItemsPanel`) through the one render pass. `MasterDetailForm` renders its child collections through the same `LineItemsField` and consulted no field-level permission, so a child column the caller may read but not edit was a live, editable cell.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`: `MasterDetailLines` reads `usePermissions()` (the same context hook `LineItemsPanel`, `ObjectForm`, `ModalForm` and `DrawerForm` read). The grid's `columns` become `applyColumnPermissions(d.columns, { perms, objectName: d.childObject })`, the same call in the same shape `LineItemsPanel` makes. ⛔ No fourth copy of the gate: the verdict is `gateByPermission`'s in `fieldWriteGate.ts`, which this PR does not touch.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.fieldWriteGate-10163.test.tsx`: a second `describe` mounts `MasterDetailForm` (edit mode, same principal, same child columns, same rows as the panel's rows) and pins the four answers below.
- `.changeset/10163-master-detail-field-write-gate.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch. Its first paragraph refers to the companion objectui#10163 entry.
- `.changeset/10163-line-items-field-write-gate.md`: final paragraph amended, prose only (see Acceptance notes).

The per-row "expand to full form" editor is not touched. It is an `ObjectForm`, whose simple variant already renders through `applyFieldPerms(formFields)`.

## Step 1: reproduced on unmodified `main` `6f96fca9`, with a lit control

Only the pin file changed, and no source was touched. Command: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.fieldWriteGate-10163.test.tsx` from the repo root, through `os-verify-lock`.

Result: **2 failed / 9 passed**, `VERDICT command-exit 1`.

| row (`MasterDetailForm`) | on `main` |
|:--|:--|
| refused column `score` (readable, not editable) | **red**: `AssertionError: expected false to be true`, at the `score` lock assertion. The lit-control assertions on `actual_value` / `indicator_name` just before it (same grid, same rows, `disabled === false`) passed, and so did the shown-values assertion. |
| unreadable column `reviewer_note` | **red**: 3 `Reviewer note` cells rendered where 0 were expected |
| CONTROL: unrestricted caller, every cell editable | green |
| CONTROL: no provider, fail-open | green |

All 7 `LineItemsPanel` rows were green.

## Ablation (fix committed first, WRAP mode, restore proven on disk)

`node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `MasterDetailForm.tsx` replaces the anchor `columns: applyColumnPermissions(d.columns, { perms, objectName: d.childObject }),` with `columns: d.columns,`.

- On-disk proof: the anchor count went from 1 to 0, and the blob went from `0a156d79780b` to `37bdd685d9db`. The replacement text went from 1 occurrence to 2 because `columns: d.columns,` already appears once, in the `deriveDetail` call.
- Result: **2 failed / 9 passed**. The refused row went red at the same `score` lock assertion and the unreadable row went red. Both `MasterDetailForm` controls and all 7 `LineItemsPanel` rows stayed green.
- Restore: the blob after restore is `0a156d79780b`, equal to the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- No `dist/` is on the path: the pin imports `./MasterDetailForm` relatively, and that file imports `./fieldWriteGate` relatively.

## Acceptance notes

- **The companion pending changeset is amended here, prose only.** `.changeset/10163-line-items-field-write-gate.md` (from PR objectui#10233, unreleased) ended by saying the master-detail child grid is not changed by this release and that objectui#10163 stays open. Both entries ship as `@object-ui/plugin-form: patch` in one fixed group, so one CHANGELOG would publish both. Its final paragraph now reads 「**Not in this entry.** The master-detail form's own child grid (`object-master-detail-form`) is covered by the companion objectui#10163 entry.」 The frontmatter is byte-identical. `check-changeset-overwrite` reports a prose correction; it does not refuse (report-only unless `OS_CHANGESET_OVERWRITE_ENFORCE=1`, which CI does not set).
- Adding and removing lines in the master-detail grid are unchanged. This PR changes only which cells are editable and which columns are shown.
- The "offer a row-expand button" condition still compares the authored column count with `formFields`. It is unchanged: the expand form is an `ObjectForm` that omits the same unreadable fields.
- Outbound: master-detail edit already sends only changed cells (PR objectui#10154). The create-mode and entry-row payload paths are unmeasured here, and no 403 is claimed.
- Docs: no page under `content/docs/` or the plugin-form README describes the grid's permission behaviour, so there was nothing to make false and none was edited. That matches the landed half.
